title: Speciesism in Natural Language Processing Research

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing NLP publication titles and contents for speciesist terminology, examining downstream NLP datasets (WNLI, Social Chemistry 101, ETHICS) for speciesist language and moral annotations, and evaluating language models (Delphi, GPT-3.5-turbo, GPT-4) by prompting them to classify the moral permissibility of speciesist actions with and without anti-speciesist instructions.
